name: youtube-agent-ru
description: Russian-language version of youtube-agent-skill by Jake Schincariol (MIT): eleven Claude skills for YouTube creators that work in Russian and English - scripts off 21 hook formulas with a scored hook, title and thumbnail linted as one pairing, an edit decision list from your transcript, a retention reader that finds the exact moments people leave, a Shorts cutter, chapters, search, comments, the weekly plan, a channel audit, and a virality engine that ranks your niche by outlier multiple rather than by channel size.
